mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS sourceBenefitId, b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, o.id AS sourceOrderId, o.order_no AS sourceOrderNo, o.product_id AS productId, o.product_name AS productName, o.store_id AS storeId, s.storeName, b.remaining_lessons AS remainingLessons, b.expire_at AS expireAt FROM pt_member_private_benefit b INNER JOIN pt_private_order o ON o.id = b.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = b.store_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId WHERE b.member_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 1 AND b.remaining_lessons > 0 AND (b.expire_at IS NULL OR b.expire_at > NOW()) AND o.member_id = #{userId} AND o.product_type_id = 2 AND o.pay_status = 2 AND o.order_status = 2 AND o.order_source = 0 ORDER BY (b.expire_at IS NULL) ASC, b.expire_at ASC, b.id ASC

SELECT u.userId AS userId, u.nickname, u.phone, u.headImgUrl, u.nowStoreId AS storeId, s.storeName FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = u.nowStoreId LEFT JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId WHERE u.isDel = 0 AND (CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) = #{keyword} OR u.phone = #{keyword}) ORDER BY u.userId ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id AS giftOrderId, o.order_no AS giftOrderNo, o.member_id AS toMemberId, o.member_name AS toMemberName, CASE WHEN LENGTH(o.member_mobile) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(o.member_mobile, 3), '****', RIGHT(o.member_mobile, 4)) ELSE o.member_mobile END AS toMemberMobile, o.product_name AS productName, o.lesson_count AS lessonCount, o.remark, o.source_order_id AS sourceOrderId, o.source_benefit_id AS sourceBenefitId, o.created_at AS createdAt, b.id AS targetBenefitId, b.expire_at AS expireAt FROM pt_private_order o LEFT JOIN pt_member_private_benefit b ON b.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_by = #{userId} AND o.order_source = 1 AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pt_private_order WHERE created_by = #{userId} AND order_source = 1 AND deleted = 0
